heading: Systems Architecture & Engineering Decisions
intro: Architectural mechanisms, trade-offs, and design boundaries implemented across production trading and distribution systems.

systems_architecture.concept: Zero-Copy Memory-Mapped Files & Blittable Value Types
systems_architecture.problem: Processing 50 instruments across 3 years of 1-minute OHLCV candles (millions of data points) in managed heap objects triggered severe Garbage Collector gen-2 collection pauses and memory bloat.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Directly maps multi-gigabyte historical market datasets into the virtual address space using sequential blittable value structs without allocating objects on the .NET managed heap.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Requires strict byte alignment, deterministic unmanaged boundary handling, and bounds checking in place of runtime GC safety.
systems_architecture.result: ~80% reduction in process memory footprint and full 50-symbol pipeline backtest execution in <3 minutes.

systems_architecture.problem: Translating high-frequency quantitative mathematical models into real-time execution required high computational speed while preserving modular strategy orchestration in C#.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Engineered P/Invoke interfaces passing pinned memory buffers and blittable pointers between C++ numerical routines and the .NET runtime.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Eliminated runtime marshalling overhead and memory copies at the cost of requiring explicit lifecycle management for pinned memory blocks.
systems_architecture.result: Near-native execution speed for vector operations while retaining flexible C# strategy composition.

systems_architecture.concept: Lock-Free Ring Buffering & Fan-Out Streaming Pipeline
systems_architecture.problem: Handling sudden exchange market volatility spikes without dropping price packets or blocking the primary ingestion socket thread during concurrent client fan-out.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Kernel TCP socket listener writes incoming tick and quote packets into an in-memory lock-free ring buffer, which worker threads dequeue and broadcast via SignalR hubs and WebSockets.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Fixed-size circular ring buffers prevent memory spikes during network stalls, requiring deterministic overflow policies under extreme backpressure.
systems_architecture.result: Verified sub-10ms distribution latency across hundreds of concurrent client endpoints with zero thread contention.

systems_architecture.problem: Static, always-on multi-asset cloud server provisioning resulted in high infrastructure costs and idle compute during off-market hours.
systems_architecture.mechanism: Designed a dynamic migration and provisioning scheduler that scales cloud resources up or down based on active market session hours (Indian, FX, Crypto) and strategy compute intensity.
systems_architecture.tradeoff: Added scheduling orchestration logic and session warm-up phases in exchange for dramatic reduction in idle runtime cost.
systems_architecture.result: 98.8% operational cost reduction while maintaining high execution reliability and support responsiveness.
